dedupe_keys.name: impact of strongback on structure with varying damper and stiffness irregularity arrangements

description: Impact of strongback on structure with varying damper and stiffness irregularity arrangements is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Mark Denavit, University of Tennessee Knoxville (utk.edu). This study explored the impacts of damper arrangement and the location of soft story vertical stiffness irregularities on the dynamic behavior and properties of a structure with a strongback. The investigation was carried out through experiments conducted on a small-scale four-story structure that was subjected to ground motion generated by a shake table. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Strongback, soft story mechanism, damper arrangement, stiffness irregularity, experimental. Published 2023-09-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
